H01.description: Initialises the per-hop _hop_unverified flag used by the D1 fix.

H02.description: Computes the sanitised provider message consumed by the D2 fix.

H03.description: The calibration exit records the raw provider error text under message_redacted (and prints it) without passing it through the redaction helper, so secret-shaped fragments can reach the envelope and stderr.

H04.description: The stderr error JSON embeds the unsanitised provider exception text.

H05.description: Unverified (above-probed-bound) status is inherited from the chain head instead of being computed per hop, so a calibrated fallback's 429 or context verdict is misclassified as unverified and not walked.

H06.description: A provider context-limit verdict on any hop is classed CEILING_UNVERIFIED_LIMIT based on the head's unverified flag rather than this hop's.

H07.description: A 429 on a calibrated fallback hop ends the call as RATE_LIMIT_UNVERIFIED (and writes a calibration record) because the head's unverified flag is used instead of the hop's.

H08.description: Adds the helper that applies the premium before flooring, used by the D3 fix.

H09.description: Comment update describing the premium recomputation.

H10.description: The long-context premium multiplies already-floored per-category costs (with float math), underbilling by the discarded remainders and dropping remainders for the premium path.

H11.description: Imports math and rejects bool values as part of the D4 multiplier validation fix.

H12.description: Non-finite multipliers (inf, nan, 1e309) pass the `> 0` check and are accepted, crashing or exploding the cost calculation instead of falling back to 1.0.

H13.description: Imports fcntl for the D5 locking fix.

H14.description: record_observed's read-append-replace cycle is not serialised across processes, so concurrent writers load the same old store and the later os.replace discards the earlier row.

H15.description: Moves directory creation ahead of the lock as part of the D5 fix.

H16.description: Adds regression tests for per-hop unverified status and message redaction.

H17.description: Adds tests for concurrent record_observed and lock-path symlink refusal.

H18.description: Adds tests for premium-before-flooring and non-finite multipliers.
